title: Pirates in Space
can_do: 同伴想法不同时提出新玩法，并把两个想法合成一个共同方案。
trigger: The child and peer want the same blanket to become two different pretend-play settings.
core_response: How about we make it a space ship?
stretch_response: What if our space ship carries pirate treasure?
repair_response: We can keep your pirates and add my space ship.
essential_props: a blanket and a paper treasure map

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Let's make the blanket a pirate ship.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: How about we make it a space ship?

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: I want pirates. I already made a treasure map.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: What if our space ship carries pirate treasure?

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Yes! We can fly to Treasure Planet.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Great. I will be the treasure captain.

replay_cards.title: Castle train
replay_cards.change: One child wants a castle and one wants a railway
replay_cards.challenge: Suggest a train that delivers people to the castle, agree on roles, and start building

replay_cards.title: Animal restaurant
replay_cards.change: One child wants animals and one wants cooking
replay_cards.challenge: Suggest a restaurant for toy animals, choose jobs, and serve the first guest

parent_support: Let the peer prefer their own idea instead of agreeing immediately.
A successful plan preserves something important from both children's ideas.
